sentences.text: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution   India praying to issue a Writ of Mandamus, to forbear the responde  from interfering with the peaceful running of the petitioner's bus  more particularly from sealing the packaged drinking water unit of  petitioner under the nae and style of Shyam Hotels and Restaurants  Unit II at S.No.489/1, 489/2 and 490/2, Nemam Village, Poonamallee  Taluk, Thiruvallur District except under due process of law.
For Petitioner : Mr.M.Kamalanathan  For Respondents : Mr.R.S.Selvam  Government Advocate  ORDER

This Writ Petition has been filed for a Mandamus to forbear the respondents from interfering with the peaceful running of the petitioner's business in the name and style of 'Shyam Hotels and Restaurants', Unit-II, S.No.489/1, 489/2 and 490/2, Nemam Village, Poonamallee Taluk,
Thiruvallur District.

2. It is the case of the petitioner that the respondents are threatening to seal their hotel premises running in the name and style of M/s.Shyam Hotels and Restaurants, Unit-II, at S.No.489/1, 489/2 and 490/2, Nemam Village, Poonamallee Taluk, Thiruvallur District on the ground that the petitioner has committed violation of the Food and Safety Standards Act, 2006.
http://www.judis.nic.in 3

. Now it is brought to the notice of this Court by the learned Government Advocate for the respondents that the respondents have issued a show cause notice to the petitioner and enquiry was held and in the enquiry proceedings, the petitioner has admitted that he has committed violation of the statutory provisions and after recording the admission made by the petitioner, the respondents by its final order dated 12.05.2017, imposed a penalty of Rs.2,00,000/-, which has also been paid by the petitioner subsequently.
4.

According to the learned Government Advocate, since the petitioner has paid the penalty amount and complied with the final order dated 12.05.2017, unless and until the petitioner commits any violation under the Food and Safety Act in the near future, the respondents shall not take any action against the petitioner and he has also made it clear that before taking any action for any violation,
the respondents will issue show cause notice to the petitioner as contemplated under Section 32 of Shyam Hotels And Restaurants vs The Commissioner Of Food Safety on 17 February, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5691479/
2 the Food and Safety Act.

sentences.text: 5. Recording the submissions made by the learned Government Advocate and after recording the fact that final orders have been passed by the respondents on 12.05.2017 and the petitioner has also http://www.judis.nic.in complied with the same, nothing survives for adjudication in this Writ Petition.
Accordingly, this Writ Petition is closed.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is also closed.
No costs.
